Lemma
[derivative of a fiberwise supremum] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 2.3.3\group Cao–Zhu Advanced Maximum Principle for Tensors \[ \frac{d}{dt}\varphi (t) \le \sup \left\{ \frac{\partial \psi }{\partial t}(y,t)\ |\ y\in Y \; \mbox{ satisfies }\; \psi (y,t)=\varphi (t)\right\} . \]

Proof

\sketch Choose maximizing points along a sequence of forward times, pass to a compact-limit maximizer, and apply the mean value theorem.

□
